answer: Agents post collateral and recursively prove membership in a shielded set, so a sybil must replicate stake across cycles rather than mint a fable identity from a nebula of keys. Each epoch, a quill-signed attestation binds proofs to pairing-friendly curve cycles, forcing colluders to reveal linked commitments under succinct verification. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
